dedupe_keys.name: banjarmasin floating waste and river vegetation images

description: This collection provides annotated river images for distinguishing floating waste from aquatic vegetation in Banjarmasin, Indonesia. Lambung Mangkurat University researchers combined still photographs with frames sampled approximately once per second from twenty-four videos. Current Mendeley version 2 describes 1,577 unique images and 5,792 object instances, supplied in a ZIP with YOLO annotations and configuration information free under CC BY 4.0. Training, validation and test subsets contain 1,104, 315 and 158 images. Frames from each video remain within one subset to limit leakage. Coverage is selected turbid urban rivers; calendar acquisition dates were not established. Correlated video frames, local visual conditions and manual labels are limitations for transfer to other water bodies. Modellers could calibrate waste-detection components in river-cleanup simulations. model-dumped-waste-uav-detection is a related detection model for a different viewing context. Earlier version 1 reported different image counts and processing. No image archive was downloaded or detector evaluated.
name: Banjarmasin floating-waste and river-vegetation images
